name: Keen Mind
summary: +1 Int; proficiency (or Expertise) in a knowledge skill, and take the Study action as a Bonus Action.

benefits.name: Lore Knowledge
benefits.summary: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature or Religion: gain proficiency, or Expertise if already proficient.
benefits.text: Choose Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature or Religion. If you aren't proficient in the chosen skill, you gain proficiency in it; if you already are, you gain Expertise in it instead.
